self.title: Hysteresis vs. Memory in Autocatalytic Reaction Networks

detail.title: Hysteresis vs. Memory in Autocatalytic Reaction Networks
detail.question: Can autocatalytic reaction networks store history-dependent states that influence future behavior, and how can these be distinguished from simple transient persistence?
detail.reason: Active attention on autocatalytic memory necessitates a focused project to address fundamental distinctions between chemical persistence and state-dependent memory, fulfilling the requirement for a new research path while the chemical heredity domain is deferred.
